'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Steve Yaeger LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Yaeger]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed)|OVS17-03-An_Unusual_Amount_Of_Fear-remaster.webp|label=An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Steven Yaeger
* '''Deck name:''' WAT Room
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
